proof_attempt_summary: D0 derived the paired-source finite categorical image and efficiency comparison, including a square-cardinality extension and a positive strict-gain family. D0.5.G rated the delivered package subfield below the required field floor (6.8 versus 7.4), so the run stopped before formalization. The mathematical referee passed, but the aggregate panel stopped at triage with duplicate-ballast and stale-justification revisions unresolved; this entry is not a panel-certified or Lean-verified theorem.
tldr: For every fixed latent cardinality \(r\ge2\) and early-proxy cardinality \(k\ge r\), an indexed margin makes the paired-source class nonempty.  The matrix pencil gives the exact causal image, reverse construction, smooth tangent, observable efficiency-gain criterion, and uniformly attaining fixed-stratum Wald procedure.  The square elbow \(k=r\) has codimension \(2r-2\), bijective bridge operators, and direct relevance to Imbens--Kallus--Mao--Wang Theorem 7 under its published premises.  A new legal \(r=k=2\) witness has exact gap \(10108/4630935>0\); splitting its first early-proxy category yields strict-gain regions for every \(r=2,k\ge3\), so the unified family covers every \(r=2,k\ge2\).  Unrestricted selection-bridge existence is locally vacuous.  These gains belong to the no-covariate, point-mass-\(S_2\), finite-categorical, known-\(r\) regular submodel; only the \(p^\dagger\) refutation of a universal Chen--Xie converse transfers upward.
gap: Published bridge work supplies identification and an outcome-moment efficiency calculation, while finite-mixture work supplies diagonalization; the March 2026 outcome-moment equivalence proof does not preserve an arbitrary supplied experimental proxy table, and the published dual-bridge efficiency theorem assumes bijectivity that fails when \(k>r\). The inherited core \(\mathrm{stat\_latentcard\_altte\_efficiency}\) supplies only the binary three-by-two structural-versus-moment witness. None of these sources gives a nonvacuous cardinality-indexed paired-source causal image, the exact rectangular dual-bridge frontier, or open strict-gain regions for every fixed \(k\ge4\).
fill: The project gives a normalized six-condition primary-text audit, an explicit nonemptiness certificate for every fixed cardinality pair, the generic image and tangent theorem with an open complement inside the outcome-moment class, a premise-by-premise finite-alphabet mapping of the dual-bridge comparator, an observable two-comparator frontier, refinement-generated strict-gain regions for every fixed \(r=2\), \(k\ge4\), and uniform fixed-stratum Wald inference with \(\rho_n\to\rho\).
